text:
jon-cust: Hey, our app started getting 404s when calling tools via the API this morning. We call tool name \"WeatherFetch\" and get 404 tool_not_found. Worked yesterday.

anna-support: sorry to hear that — can you paste the exact request you sent (curl or SDK) and the response body?

jon-cust: curl sent: ```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood/v1/tools/call \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-xxx' \n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n  -d '{"tool_name": "WeatherFetch", "args": {"zip": "94110"}}'
```
response: ```json
{
  "error": {"code":"tool_not_found","message":"tool 'WeatherFetch' not found"}
}
```

anna-support: thanks. Quick questions: did you recently update client SDK or change casing? and can you share org/team id privately?

jon-cust: no SDK change. We did rename an internal handle last week from \"weather_fetch\" -> \"WeatherFetch\" to match UI but server calls used to accept both. Org is org_554.

anna-support: copying in @mike-oncall and @sara-eng to investigate. please hold on any pivots. :hourglass:

mike-oncall: pinging registry service logs now. Can you repro by hitting our staging with same payload?

jon-cust: yes repros against prod and staging. Staging shows same 404.

sara-eng: initial quick triage: 404 suggests tool registry lookup failed to match alias. Two possibilities: alias/backfill job didn't finish OR casefold/unicode normalization mismatch introduced by recent rename tool. I'm going to run a query against the registry for org_554.

registry-bot: query result for org_554: entries: ["weather_fetch" (uuid: t-aaaa), "WeatherFetch\u00AD" (uuid: t-bbbb, alias: true), "WEATHER_FETCH" (uuid: t-cccc)]

mike-oncall: wait that middle entry has a SOFT HYPHEN (U+00AD) at the end. looks like UI rename accidentally included a soft-hyphen char. our lookup uses casefold + simple trim but does NOT strip soft-hyphen. client supplied "WeatherFetch" (no soft-hyphen) so match missed.

anna-support: oh interesting. so customer-visible name is same visually but underlying alias contains invisible character. Could explain why it worked earlier?

sara-eng: timeline: rename was applied 2024-01-15, backfill job ran but had an intermittent UTF normalization bug around 02:10 UTC that skipped normalization for some aliases. That cluster had a transient failure and retried later, but retry path didn't re-normalize existing alias text. So a small subset of aliases contain non-NFC characters.

mike-oncall: repro steps for engineers:
1) curl tool lookup: ```bash
curl -s -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-xxx' https://registry.internal/v1/orgs/org_554/tools?name=WeatherFetch | jq -r .items[]
```
2) inspect unicode: ```bash
python - <<'PY'
import unicodedata, sys
s='WeatherFetch\u00ad'
print(repr(s))
print([hex(ord(c)) for c in s])
print(unicodedata.normalize('NFC', s))
PY
```

sara-eng: mitigation options:
- short: create explicit alias without soft-hyphen for affected tool uuids and propagate;
- medium: run backfill job that normalizes all aliases to NFC+casefold, idempotent;
- long: patch rename/backfill pipeline to enforce normalization before persist and add unit test.

anna-support: sent jon-cust a DM: we can add a temporary alias right now while eng fixes backfill. Do you want us to add alias \"WeatherFetch\" to uuid t-bbbb?

jon-cust: yes please, that should unblock us.

mike-oncall: adding alias now via admin CLI: ```bash
redwood-admin alias create --org org_554 --tool t-bbbb --alias "WeatherFetch" --reason "support unblock (soft-hyphen mismatch)"
```

registry-bot: alias create succeeded (alias id: a-3301). propagation to edge caches in ~60s.

jon-cust: confirmed calls now succeed, thanks! :tada:

anna-support: leaving this thread open until eng deploys permanent fix. cc @sara-eng please file a postmortem / changelog entry.

sara-eng: filing a short incident note. root cause: rename pipeline allowed non-normalized unicode (soft-hyphen) into alias string; lookup code used casefolding but didn't normalize non-printing characters. Fixes: enforce NFC normalization + drop/control invisible chars at write time; run normalization backfill for all orgs; add unit/regression tests. ETA for fix: 48h, backfill rolling over weekend.

mike-oncall: created JIRA INF-4321: "alias normalization: strip soft/hyphen and enforce NFC on writes" assigned to eng-infra, priority P1. Backfill job INF-4322 scheduled with throttling.

anna-support: Jon, we'll keep you updated in this thread and email once backfill completes. really sorry for disruption.

jon-cust: great, thanks everyone for fast turnaround. appreciate the alias workaround.

sara-eng: followup note for engineers: watch for increased API 404s during rename windows; consider adding heuristics to treat visually equivalent characters as matches for a short grace period to reduce customer impact on renames.

anna-support: marking as resolved for customer side; internal follow-ups ongoing. :white_check_mark:
